newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Sogem in Centaur mining deal.
newsitem.headline: Sogem in Centaur mining deal.

text.p: SA Sogem, the international commercial arm of the Belgian non-ferrous group Union Miniere, said on Thursday it and Centaur Mining and Exploration Ltd reached a cooperation agreement on the development of Centaur's nickel and cobalt laterite project in Western Australia.

Under the deal Sogem will receive exclusive marketing rights for Centaur's production of nickel cathodes and cobalt by-products in exchange for financial, technical, and commercial support for the first stage of the the 196 million Australian dollar mining and processing project.

"Sogem is to help Centaur in arranging additional banking facilities required for the project and with the help of Union Miniere will provide advice to Centaur on technical issues," Sogem said in a statement.
Centaur's nickel production, expected to commence in January 1998, will increase from 10,000 tonnes per year to 40,000 tonnes in the second stage.
